evidence.reason: Hold.acquire now tracks marker creation separately from token persistence (Hold.created), removes the runner-disabled marker only when the persisted bytes prove ownership, and otherwise raises RecoveryRequired carrying the retained marker path and token so an unpersisted marker is reported as acquired admission (exit 3 recovery_required) instead of an unchanged-host refusal with exit 2; regression tests were added but could not be executed because the harness permits only git inspection commands.
